blocks.prompt: 6 If \(\omega\) is a cube root of unity, form an equation whose roots are \(2\omega\) and \(2\omega^{2}\).
blocks.explanation: Is sawal mein roots diye gaye hain aur humein ulta kaam karna hai: un roots se quadratic equation banani hai. Iska seedha formula hai: agar roots ka sum \(S\) aur product \(P\) ho to equation \(x^{2}-Sx+P=0\) hoti hai. Yahan \(\omega\) se muraad complex cube root of unity hai (agar \(\omega=1\) lete to dono roots 2 ho jaate aur sawal be-maani hota). Plan: \(\omega+\omega^{2}=-1\) aur \(\omega^{3}=1\) se \(S\) aur \(P\) nikaalein, phir formula mein rakh dein.
steps:
Step 1: Roots ka sum
\[S=2\omega+2\omega^{2}\]
\[=2(\omega+\omega^{2})\]
\[=2(-1)=-2\]
Kyun: Dono terms mein 2 common tha, use bahar nikaala. Bracket mein \(\omega+\omega^{2}\) bana, jo \(-1\) hai.

Step 2: Roots ka product
\[P=(2\omega)(2\omega^{2})\]
\[=4\omega^{3}=4\]
Kyun: Numbers ko numbers se multiply kiya (\(2\times2=4\)) aur \(\omega\) ki powers jama kin (\(1+2=3\)); \(\omega^{3}=1\). \(\omega\) dono jagah ghaib ho gaya, is liye equation ke coefficients real aayenge.

Step 3: Equation banayein
\[x^{2}-Sx+P=0\]
\[x^{2}-(-2)x+4=0\]
\[x^{2}+2x+4=0\]
Kyun: Jis quadratic ke roots \(\alpha,\beta\) hon woh \((x-\alpha)(x-\beta)=x^{2}-(\alpha+\beta)x+\alpha\beta\) hai, yahi \(x^{2}-Sx+P\) hai.
Dhyan dein: formula mein \(S\) se pehle minus hai. \(S=-2\) rakhne par \(-(-2)=+2\) banta hai; yahan \(x^{2}-2x+4\) likh dena bohat aam ghalti hai.

Tasdeeq: equation solve karke dekhein
\[x=\dfrac{-2\pm\sqrt{4-16}}{2}\]
\[x=-1\pm\sqrt{3}i\]
Kyun: Yeh bilkul \(2\omega\) aur \(2\omega^{2}\) hain, jo humein Sawal 1 (i) mein mile the. Banayi hui equation ke roots wahi nikle jo diye gaye the, to equation sahih hai.
blocks.final_answer: \(x^{2}+2x+4=0\). Dilchasp baat: yeh wahi quadratic factor hai jo Sawal 1 (i) mein \(x^{3}-8\) ko factorize karte waqt bana tha.
